{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Identify rows with missing flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
missing_rows = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull() | penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull()]

# Check if the missing rows are systematically different in species or island
# We already know they are Adelie (Torgersen) and Gentoo (Biscoe)
# Now check the full distribution of species and island in the dataset vs. missing rows

# Full dataset
full_species = penguins['species'].value_counts(normalize=True)
full_island = penguins['island'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Missing rows
missing_species = missing_rows['species'].value_counts(normalize=True)
missing_island = missing_rows['island'].value_counts(normalize=True)

print("Full dataset proportions:")
print(full_species)
print("\nMissing rows proportions:")
print(missing_species)

print("\nFull dataset island proportions:")
print(full_island)
print("\nMissing rows island proportions:")
print(missing_island)"}
